content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Online gumroad

The absence of Stripe in 149 countries out of 195 worldwide, including Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan, underscores a significant gap in digital commerce infrastructure. This limitation forces creators to seek alternative, often unreliable methods for selling their products online. However, with the advent of sovereign commerce infrastructure, digital creators can now bypass these restrictions and maintain full ownership and control over their digital storefronts.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Sovereign commerce infrastructure operates by leveraging free and paid tools to create a fully operational online store. This includes utilizing GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Additionally, NOWPayments enables automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a minimal 0.5% fee, ensuring a seamless transaction process without the need for conventional payment platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers digital creators with full control over their online stores.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of sovereign commerce infrastructure include hosting solutions like Cloudflare Pages, backend logic tools such as Cloudflare Workers, database services like Supabase, file delivery systems including Cloudflare R2, and payment processing through NOWPayments. These components work in tandem to provide a comprehensive and scalable solution for digital creators, ensuring that they can manage and grow their online businesses effectively.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can start by selecting the appropriate components based on their specific needs. This might involve choosing Cloudflare Pages for hosting and Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, alongside Supabase for order storage and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. By following a structured deployment plan and considering the available support options, such as the Edge Commerce Stack, creators can rapidly set up their online store and begin selling their digital products securely and efficiently.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, you can use sovereign commerce infrastructure as an alternative. This involves setting up your own online store with automatic crypto payment processing, leveraging platforms like NOWPayments that support over 300 cryptocurrencies and charge only a 0.5% fee, ensuring you maintain control and ownership of your storefront.
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal 0.5% transaction fee.

You can explore this and other options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, finding the perfect fit for your digital commerce needs.
Your Deployment Checklist

To get started with deploying your sovereign commerce infrastructure, first select your hosting platform, such as Cloudflare Pages. Next, choose a backend logic tool like Cloudflare Workers and set up your order storage with Supabase. Then, configure your file delivery system using Cloudflare R2 and integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Finally, test your setup end-to-end to ensure a seamless customer experience, and consider support options like the Edge Commerce Stack for a hassle-free deployment.

NOWPayments charges a minimal 0.5% fee for transaction processing, with no additional costs for setup or maintenance.

Yes, with solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack, you can have a fully operational online store deployed in 48 hours, complete with support for any questions you might have.

NOWPayments offers highly secure payment processing, utilizing on-chain crypto transactions that are verified automatically, ensuring a reliable and trustworthy payment experience for your customers.

While having some coding knowledge can be helpful, it's not necessary with solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack, which provides a pre-configured setup that can be deployed quickly without extensive technical expertise.
